name: discord-7d2d-status-bridge
description: 7 Days to Die Discord bridge with chat relay, monitoring events, blood moon notices, and an editable Polish server status message.

chatChannelId.description: Discord channel ID for player chat relay.

monitoringChannelId.description: Discord channel ID for system/death/join/leave/blood moon/status messages.

relayDiscordToGame.description: Relay messages from the Discord chat channel into game chat.

relayGameToDiscord.description: Relay in-game chat messages to the Discord chat channel.

updateStatusMessage.description: Update one persistent bot message with current server status instead of posting a new status every tick.

serverstats.helpText: Shows online player count, current day, time, and blood moon indicator.

discordChatRelay.description: Relays Discord chat channel messages into game chat.

gameChatRelay.description: Relays in-game chat messages to Discord chat channel.

monitorJoin.description: Sends player join messages to the monitoring channel.

monitorLeave.description: Sends player leave messages to the monitoring channel.

monitorDeath.description: Sends player death messages to the monitoring channel.

updateStatus.description: Updates the persistent Discord server status message.

bloodMoonMonitor.description: Checks 7D2D time and sends blood moon day/start/end notices.
